system_overview: ml-feature-store is a batch feature store with point-in-time joins for churn models. It is built as a small focused system with Feature Registry at its core, supported by Backfill Runner (Spark) and Serving Cache.

recommended_language.rationale: Python fits the batch feature store with point-in-time joins for churn models workload on technical grounds.

quality_goals.goal: Correct output under normal failure modes

architecture_decisions.title: Use Feature Registry as the system core
architecture_decisions.rationale: The batch feature store with point-in-time joins for churn models hinges on this component working well.

positive: Single place to harden the critical path
negative: Core component becomes a bottleneck for change

ruled_out.rejection_reason: Operational overhead for a small system.

architecture_decisions.title: Run Serving Cache asynchronously
architecture_decisions.rationale: Keeps the interactive path fast on modest hardware.

ruled_out.rejection_reason: Ties user latency to slow external work.

what_not_to_build: A plugin system before there are users

risk_flags.risk: External dependency outage stalls the async path
risk_flags.mitigation: Retry with backoff and a dead-letter table.

open_questions: What is the realistic peak concurrent usage?
constraints: Entities Feature, FeatureSet, TrainingRun must persist relationally
Components: Feature Registry, Backfill Runner (Spark), Serving Cache
